topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe it's been days since I heard about this, and I'm just reaching out now. Man, I've been tearing myself apart over this whole mess. When I think about all the times we laughed, all the secrets we shared, and then to hear that none of it even registered for them... It's like a punch in the gut. I wish I could go back and make it right, but I don't even know where to start. What if I did something without even knowing? I just keep thinking, maybe if I'd stayed in touch more, if I hadn't let so much time slip away... I don’t know, maybe there's still a chance we can pick up from here, somehow. I just wish I could undo all of this.
